title: Frontier AI Safety and Alignment Research Scientist, DeepMind

desc: As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits Learn more about benefits at Google . Lead foundational and empirical research in AI safety and alignment, from mathematical formulation and algorithmic design through validation on frontier architectures. Characterize failure modes in frontier models, including newly uncovered ones, using interpretability research (mechanistic, latent-space, or black-box), and turn those findings into safeguards, mitigations, and alignment improvements. Propose novel research directions and develop scalable alignment and control interventions, including reinforcement learning methods, that anticipate vulnerabilities as AI systems become increasingly complex. Share research outcomes with internal teams across DeepMind and publish them at premier peer-reviewed AI conferences and venues. Collaborate with frontier modeling, safety, security, and product teams across DeepMind to turn scientific breakthroughs into deployed safeguards. Industry experience working with AI-assisted coding and AI tools. Sitting at the intersection of investments, data and technology, the role will develop analytical tools and data infrastructure that enable Portfolio Managers, Asset Management and Risk to monitor performance, compare realized outcomes with underwriting assumptions and identify emerging risks and opportunities. Build and automate data flows with Technology to support accurate exposure, collateral, cash-flow and performance monitoring. Develop consistent surveillance across standardized asset types such as consumer loans, student loans and auto finance, and extend capabilities over time to mortgage whole loans and other private asset classes. Reconcile realized performance against underwriting assumptions, identify material variances and help translate findings into actionable insights for Portfolio Managers, Asset Management and Risk. Partner with public- and private-side Technology teams to develop reusable tools and APIs for investment and analytical platforms. Work directly with Portfolio Managers, Asset Management, Risk and quantitative modelers to identify gaps in investment performance analysis, assumptions and models. Produce clear surveillance reporting and, over time, targeted sector research to identify performance trends and relative-value opportunities. Strong quantitative skills and a solid understanding of structured credit and asset-backed investments; experience with private credit or asset-backed finance is strongly preferred. Hands-on working knowledge of Python and SQL, with the ability to query data, develop analytical tools and automate repeatable processes. Experience working with loan-level, collateral, cash-flow or investment-performance data and translating analysis into practical investment insights. Ability to work independently in an evolving environment, shape solutions from ambiguous requirements and partner effectively across investment, risk and technology teams. desc: Data Scientist, AI & Generative AI The Opportunity Want to build AI solutions that solve real business problems and make financial services simpler for millions of customers? Join John Hancock’s AI team and help transform how we use data and artificial intelligence across our U.S. Insurance business. From making life insurance easier to buy to improving sales, marketing, in-force operations, and claims, our team is applying machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI to create smarter and more seamless experiences. You’ll also become part of a 260+ member data science community across John Hancock and Manulife , giving you the opportunity to collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas with AI and data experts around the world. We’re looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys experimenting with emerging technologies and turning great ideas into scalable, production-ready solutions. You’ll work across the AI lifecycle, from data exploration and experimentation to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. If you’re excited about machine learning, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, and cloud-based AI , this is an opportunity to build technology with meaningful business impact. What You’ll Do Build AI solutions from idea to production: Research, develop, test, and deploy machine learning, Generative AI, and analytical models that solve real business challenges. Develop agentic AI systems: Build AI agents and intelligent workflows using retrieval, orchestration, structured tool use, event-driven integration, and human-in-the-loop approaches. Experiment and innovate: Develop proof of concepts and pilots, evaluate new approaches, and help transition successful solutions into production. Turn data into action: Partner with stakeholders to understand business challenges, uncover insights, define meaningful KPIs, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Productionize AI: Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to build scalable, reliable, and secure AI solutions. Improve performance: Monitor models and AI applications, analyze results, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve quality and effectiveness. Partner across teams: Explain complex data science and AI concepts in a clear, practical way to both technical and non-technical audiences. Stay at the forefront of AI: Explore emerging developments across cloud AI, LLMs, agentic systems, machine learning platforms, and data science tools. What You Bring 2+ years of industry experience developing and deploying machine learning, AI, or Generative AI solutions, with a strong foundation in data science and AI. Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or Physics . Strong programming skills in Python and SQL , with experience using Java . Hands-on experience across the AI and data science lifecycle, including exploratory data analysis, data cleansing, feature engineering, experimentation, model development, deployment, and monitoring . Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vectorization, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI techniques . Experience building AI-enabled applications, agents, or automated workflows using retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, and structured outputs . Experience with Databricks , data modeling, and building data products. Exposure to Azure AI services, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), GitHub Actions, and enterprise observability tools . Experience with distributed computing technologies such as Spark or Hadoop and cloud environments including Azure, AWS, or GCP . Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and identifying opportunities to improve existing solutions. Excellent communication skills with the ability to make complex AI and data concepts understandable to a wide range of audiences. LLMOps or AgentOps , including model and prompt versioning, evaluation datasets, automated quality gates, tracing, telemetry, regression management, and rollout strategies. Responsible AI and AI governance , particularly around privacy, security, compliance, enterprise risk, and model risk. Developing AI or intelligent automation solutions for financial services, insurance, financial operations, or other regulated environments . Measuring AI solutions through metrics such as adoption, operational efficiency, quality, risk reduction, developer productivity, or customer outcomes. This isn’t just an opportunity to experiment with AI. It’s an opportunity to build it, deploy it, and see the impact it creates. The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.
